title: Progress or Regress? Self-Improvement Reversal in Post-training

contributions.purpose: 填补对迭代 post-training 自改进方法效果与机制缺乏系统理解的空白,为实践者提供选择方法的指引
contributions.mechanism: 系统化形式化当前 post-training 范式,把影响因素解耦为初始模型 M、任务数据集 D、迭代步数 T、post-training 方法 F(iterative SFT / iterative DPO / iterative SFT-DPO),分离变量做大规模实验分析
contributions.evaluation: 在 CSQA、GSM8K、MATH、MBPP 四个基准上用 LLaMA2-7B / Mistral-7B / LLaMA3-8B 全参微调;pass@1 普遍随迭代提升但 4-5 轮后趋于平台或略降;LLaMA2-7B 改进空间更大(GSM8K iterative SFT 5 轮 +12.31)
contributions.domain: 大语言模型 / 后训练自改进 (数学推理/代码/常识)
contributions.source_quote: Systematic Analysis: In Sections 3 and 4, we systematically formulate current post-training methodologies and conduct extensive experiments to examine how various factors influence self-improvement in solving challenging tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first in-depth overview of these influencing factors.

contributions.purpose: 超越表面的 pass@1 指标,更全面刻画自改进中 LLM 表现的多个维度
contributions.mechanism: 提出一套评测框架/指标,评估改进问题覆盖、解答多样性(solution diversity)和 OOD 泛化能力在迭代过程中的变化
contributions.evaluation: N=50 采样(top-p 0.95, temp 0.75)构造偏好数据,gold label 二值 reward;greedy/zero-shot 评测;指标随迭代呈现与 pass@1 相反的下降趋势
contributions.domain: 大语言模型 / 评测方法
contributions.source_quote: Metric Innovation: In Section 5, we propose a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics to better capture the multifaceted nature of LLM performance in self-improvement practices.

contributions.purpose: 揭示自改进实践的隐患,警示当前做法不足以让模型真正解决更复杂问题
contributions.mechanism: 基于所提指标做实证分析,识别 self-improvement reversal 现象
contributions.evaluation: 实证:pass@1 准确率上升的同时,解答多样性与 OOD 泛化等关键能力持续下降(悖论式反转),跨三模型四基准一致
contributions.domain: 大语言模型 / 后训练自改进
contributions.source_quote: Identified Phenomenon: In Section 5, based on the proposed evaluation metrics, we reveal the phenomenon of self-improvement reversal, where increases in pass@1 accuracy compromise other essential capabilities such as solution diversity and OOD generalization.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Building on the concept of self-training (Grandvalet & Bengio, 2004), wherein models bootstrap their own generated responses for iterative training ... STaR (Zelikman et al., 2022) has demonstrated that leveraging model's self-generated reasoning steps for iterative supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can effectively enhance its reasoning abilities.
Recently, Pang et al. (2024) examined iterative preference learning in the context of reasoning tasks, marking the first study to expand beyond instruction tuning.
For the implementation of preference-based learning, we utilize DPO (Rafailov et al., 2023) due to its scalability and efficiency.

notes: 全文核心即一个负面/警示性结果:self-improvement reversal——pass@1 提升的同时 solution diversity 与 OOD 泛化持续退化,作者明确论证当前 post-training 自改进"不足以"应对更复杂问题。另有多处 trade-off/平台观察:pass@1 随迭代 4-5 轮后收益递减甚至下降;更强的初始模型(LLaMA3-8B)最终最优精度更高但改进幅度反而不如 LLaMA2-7B。方法建立在 self-training(Grandvalet & Bengio 2004)、STaR、Pang et al. 2024 迭代偏好学习之上,偏好学习实现直接采用 DPO。这是批判性评测论文,非提升 SOTA 的方法论文。
